en.headline: Government leans toward 10 to 12 hours of civil service family leave
en.dek: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung Ho Poi-yan said the planned hourly leave is meant for sudden family needs and that applications should be simple, with a final figure still to be set.
body: The government is inclined to give civil servants 10 to 12 hours of family care leave a year from next year, Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung Ho Poi-yan told a Legislative Council panel on Wednesday, saying the exact allocation has not been finalised.

Yeung said the leave is intended for sudden needs such as collecting a child after an unplanned school closure or looking after an elderly relative for a short period. She told the Panel on Public Service that applications should be straightforward and that a supervisor who is satisfied with the reason may approve leave even if documents cannot be produced immediately, with proof supplied later if required.

Deputy Secretary Chan Yuen-tak said detailed criteria and departmental guidelines are being drafted. A lawmaker suggested matching the three-day parental leave already available, which at eight hours a day would amount to 24 hours a year; Yeung said existing leave types already cover many situations and the new entitlement is meant only for brief absences.

The administration has in recent years added marriage leave, compassionate leave and three days of parental leave for staff with children under three. Yeung said she believed colleagues would not abuse the new arrangement.

zh.headline: 公僕照顧家庭假傾向每年10至12小時
zh.dek: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵在立法會表示，假期旨在應付突發家事，申請程序擬從簡，確實時數仍未定案，預計明年推出。
body: 政府擬明年為公務員增設「照顧家庭假」。公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵周三在立法會公務員及資助機構員工事務委員會表示，目前傾向每年提供10至12小時，確實安排仍未作最終決定。
楊何蓓茵指，假期原意是讓同事應付突發需要，例如學校臨時停課須接送子女，或短暫照顧長者。她說申請方法應盡量簡便，只要上司信納理由即可批准，即使當時未能出示證明，亦可事後補交。
副秘書長陳元德表示，當局正制定詳細準則，稍後向各部門發出指引。有議員建議參考現有三天育兒假、以每日八小時計算即每年24小時；楊何蓓茵回應，政府已設有多類假期，新安排主要方便員工短暫處理家事。
近年政府已先後推出婚假、恩恤假，以及育有三歲以下子女的三天育兒假。楊何蓓茵表示相信同事不會濫用新機制。
